notes.title: Backrooms Event - Extended
notes.content:
[p][b]Backrooms Event Extended
[/b] 
- The Backrooms are not done with you yet. 
- The event is [b]extended by one more week[/b] (3rd of September) so everyone gets a fair shot at claiming the limited time item that slipped through because of the recent bugs. 
- [b]A big thank you to the community.[/b] Your reports and feedback made it possible for us to track these issues down fast. We see you diving in, testing, and sharing your experiences, and it keeps pushing us to make the game better. 
- We have also added a [b]new toggle in the save settings menu[/b] that lets you turn the Backrooms event on or off whenever you want. This is only temporary. In a [b]future update with new scenarios[/b], the Backrooms will return as its own dedicated scenario. 

- [b]The Backrooms are calling.[/b] One more week. Do you dare go back in?



__ New Features __[/p][p]- Added three new events that can occur in the Backrooms (including a new monster!)[/p][p][/p][p]- Added a new wearable Head-Lamp for your character (Light shines in the direction you face)[/p][p][/p][p]- Lights (both left and right) have been added for the Golf dome.[/p][p][/p][p]- Reflections have been added to the game, offering a more immersive experience with your shiny cars![/p][p][/p][p]- A new button was added in the Game Options when loading a Save to disable currently running Events.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]__ Improvements __[/p][p]The Backrooms have been updated with added complexity to enhance both challenge and atmosphere.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]__ Performance & Visuals __[/p][p]This update focuses on engine optimization. While this is not the “big performance overhaul” yet, it should make things feel smoother in certain areas. Especially multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][p]- Added dedicated physics thread support. Towing and vehicle interactions now run smoother and with less CPU strain.[/p][p][/p][p]- Disabled physics rewind system. Lowers CPU and network overhead in multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][p]- Improved streaming and async loading. Reduces stutters when new areas stream in.[/p][p][/p][p]- Enabled shader caching and pipeline state optimizations. Less shader compilation stutter. You will still stutter first time loading up a POI, the next time will be noticeably better.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: Multiplayer and towing will still be laggy and FPS will be low. This patch isn’t a magic fix. But these optimizations should help things feel a little smoother and more stable for now.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]__ Graphics __[/p][p]Community mod *UnMaskFX* has begun integration into the game, bringing its first set of graphics and performance improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]- Added two new W.I.P. graphics presets. Potato and cinematic mode. Potato was designed for ultra low end hardware. Cinematic was designed for high end GPUs like a RTX 4090/5090[/p][p][/p][p]- Reworked Performance / Balanced / Quality presets for smoother scaling across hardware.[/p][p][/p][p]- Reflections now scale correctly across presets. Potato and Performance settings have these turned off[/p][p][/p][p]- DX12 Quality uses Lumen GI & Reflections. DX11 Quality uses the fallback non-Lumen path for better stability.[/p][p][/p][p]- Texture streaming rebalanced. Reduces VRAM spikes and improves stability across more GPUs.[/p][p][/p][p]- Shadows, post-processing, foliage, and effects now scale more consistently between presets.[/p][p]- Local exposure in first person driving improved.[/p][p][/p][p]Note: In a future update we plan to allow players to select individual graphics settings instead of just the five presets. [/p][p][/p][p]Both new graphics settings may have small bugs and lighting issues. Please report them on our official discord.[/p][p][/p][p]Textures may fail if your system has less than 6GB of Vram. 4GB and under users can play the game but may experience graphical and texture issues.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]__ Bug Fixes __[/p][p]- Fixed missing hitbox for windows in Fish Garage POI.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed misaligned water in cow paddock trough.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed cars not moving when weight is activated.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed "Drunken Clouds" issue where client could not connect to host and got stuck on a drunken screen (unable to press escape)[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed bears sometimes despawning instead of exploding for clients.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed police light bar lights pointing down/no lights.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed Triclops speedometer brightness.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed floating caps on Kart.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed bug where UAZ lighting had wrong light set up for interior light, and could not be reattached once removed[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed black ground and overexposed sky issue when backrooms spawn in overworld[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed exhaust particles. Should be visible during the day now.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed collision on chameleon statue on roof of gas station's. Players can now get around it.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed missing garage doors.[/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed part counter on cars.[/p][p][/p][p]- Kart now spawns when selecting as starter vehicle.[/p][p][/p][p]- The car turning when driving backwards has been improved.[/p][p][/p][p]- W.I.P Dada front and rear lights always activated fixed + dashboard light half fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]- W.I.P. Clients being unable to accelerate heavy vehicles. (Only works with original engine)[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – Multiplayer Stability & Gameplay Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just pushed a new patch focused on improving multiplayer stability, fixing item spawns, and polishing overall gameplay.

[list]

[*][b]🎒 Pickable items now reactivate properly[/b]
Items that sometimes became unpickupable for clients now behave correctly without needing manual intervention.

[*][b]⚙️ Original part counter updated[/b]
The counter now count the full number of parts when restoring vehicles. It was modified depending on if wheel were intalled or nor for example.

[*][b]🛠️ Infinite food exploit removed[/b]
You can no longer eat endlessly by putting an empty food can back into your inventory.

[*][b]🚗 Ejection visual bug corrected[/b]
Passengers ejected from vehicles in third-person view no longer incorrectly see their head in first-person.

[*][b]🎮 FOV limits properly applied[/b]
Field of view values are now clamped to avoid extreme and unrealistic settings.

[*][b]🚙 IFA dashboard mountable[/b]
The IFA vehicle dashboard can now be properly installed.

[*][b]🛠️ Part spawn randomness improved[/b]
Certain parts no longer spawn five times in a row.

[*][b]🚀 Teleport bug after inspecting ragdolled players resolved[/b]
Inspecting a player who was ragdolled no longer sends you flying across the map.

[*][b]🖥️ Crash on startup resolved for affected users[/b]
A crash that prevented some players from launching the game has been fixed.

[*][b]🛞 Prevented "M" flying glitch[/b]
Rapidly pressing "M" after leaving a car no longer causes your character to fly away.

[*][b]🌍 Level spawning corrected for clients[/b]
Level now properly spawn on the client side.

[*][b]🛣️ Road artifact bug fixed in multiplayer[/b]
Roads no longer produce visual artifacts on the server side during multiplayer sessions.
[/list]

Thanks again for your support and detailed reports — the game keeps getting better thanks to you!
More fixes, optimizations, and improvements are on the way 🚗💨

— The Drive Beyond Horizons Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Hotfix – Save, Vehicle, and UI Improvements
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just rolled out a small patch to address a few save system, UI, and vehicle-related issues:

[list]

The doors on your vehicles will now be correctly saved and restored between sessions.

When saving at high speed, you will now respawn properly next to your vehicle, instead of far away.

[*][b]✅ Fixed: C18 restoration requirement[/b]
The C18 no longer needs the Dada's fuel tank cap to be considered fully restorable.

[*][b]✅ Fixed: Fuel tank display synchronization[/b]
The server and client now correctly see the same amount of fuel in a tank — no more desync between players.

[/list]

Thanks again for your feedback and reports — each update gets us closer to a smoother experience. 🚗💨
More fixes and improvements are coming soon!

— The Drive Beyond Horizons Team

notes.title: 🚘 Patch Notes – Vehicle Handling, UI Feedback & New Features
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Here’s a fresh update focused on making vehicles feel more stable, improving UI feedback, and adding some fun and polish along the way!

[list]

[*][b]🖼️ TAA Ghosting improvement (experimental)[/b]
We’ve begun improving anti-aliasing ghosting based on feedback from the community (shoutout to Dr Rockso!). This is an early pass — more tweaks to come.

[*][b]🎮 New: Adjustable FOV up to 120°[/b]
You can now change your field of view in the gameplay options — up to 120° for those who love the wide-angle feel.

[*][b]🖥️ New: V-Sync option added[/b]
You can now enable or disable vertical sync in the graphics settings — helpful for screen tearing.

[*][b]🛞 Handling Update: Wheel grip stabilization[/b]
We’ve reworked vehicle wheel behavior — the grip no longer changes unpredictably after extended use, resulting in more consistent driving.

[*][b]🚙 Musgoat now spawns with a handbrake[/b]
No more struggling to stop on a slope — the Musgoat now comes equipped with a handbrake by default.

[*][b]📦 Original parts visual feedback[/b]
When restoring a car, you’ll now see:

Total original parts installed

Green preview boxes = correct part

Yellow = compatible but not the original part

[*][b]🚪 Door compatibility improvement[/b]
Doors from different vehicles now align better — pivot points have been corrected so they attach properly.

[*][b]📶 Radio tower improvements[/b]
We’ve improved the performance and save reliability of radio towers in the world.

[*][b]🌡️ Engine overheating feedback[/b]
Engines now display a warning when they’re too hot — and they’ll cool down even when sitting on the ground.

[*][b]🔊 Car Restoration Sound[/b]
A unique sound now plays when you complete a full car restoration — satisfying and clear!

[*][b]🔉 Audio balancing – Car attenuation pass[/b]
Wwise settings have been tweaked to better balance car-related sounds, especially wide attenuation.

[*][b]🪩 New Item: Disco Ball[/b]
Because every good road trip needs a little party flair. 🕺

[*][b]⚖️ Fixed: Weight capacity replication bug[/b]
A bug caused vehicle weight limits to desync in multiplayer, making some cars undriveable for clients — now fixed.

[*][b]🎒 Fixed: Backpack interaction in multiplayer[/b]
Clients can once again use their backpacks reliably in multiplayer sessions.

[/list]

Thanks again for your continued support and all your bug reports — they help us improve the game every week.

— The Drive Beyond Horizons Team

notes.title: 🚀 Patch Notes – Optimization Pass, Save Fixes & New Features
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just released a new update with a strong focus on optimization, along with many bug fixes, quality-of-life changes, and new features based on your feedback.

[list]

[*][b]🚀 Major Optimization: Zombie unloading & performance spikes[/b]
We’ve fixed a critical issue where zombies were never unloaded from memory, causing major performance drops as you explored.
We’ve also reduced some lag spikes — they’re not gone yet, but much better.
🧠 Next step: VRAM optimization to fix blurry visuals on long sessions and reduce micro-freezes even further.

[*][b]💾 Fixed: Missing saves due to special characters[/b]
If your Steam name contains special characters like _, the game couldn’t read your save.
From now on, save names default to the seed only.
To recover old saves, go to:
AppData/Local/DriveBeyondHorizons/Saved/SaveGames/
Find the file with your name + seed, remove the special character from the filename, and it should appear again.
Need help? Ask on Discord!

[*][b]🛢️ New: Universal siphoning + direction control[/b]
You can now siphon fuel with any container, and reverse flow direction using the mouse wheel.

[*][b]🎲 Temporary fix: Item spawn now always random (no seed)[/b]
Until we rework the seed system, items now spawn with full randomness to prevent missing spawns tied to specific seeds.

[*][b]📦 Optimization: Loot meshes (LODs & collision)[/b]
Improved performance by adding proper LODs and simplified collision to lootable objects.

[*][b]🐢 Added: Fred the Turtle[/b]
Yes. 🐢

[*][b]🚙 Towing: Better detachment logic[/b]
Vehicles now automatically detach from tows if angular velocity becomes excessive, preventing buggy explosions.

[*][b]🚗 Chameleon gas station updates[/b]

Fixed garage door interaction

Optimized meshes & simplified collision

Fixed sticking issues while crouched

[*][b]🎵 Adjusted: Main menu music volume[/b]
Lowered music volume, based on feedback.

[*][b]🔄 UI Fix: Mouse wheel interaction UI[/b]
Rotating UI elements no longer reappear when entering/exiting vehicles.

[*][b]🧼 Brush fix: Save state properly[/b]
Brushes no longer show bristles after being emptied and reloaded.

[*][b]🚽 Peeing now works even with thirst disabled[/b]
Yup. All functional now, even in god mode 😅

[*][b]🔊 Adjusted: Teddy bear sound balancing[/b]
All bear sounds are now easier to hear and more consistent.

[*][b]🧢 Improved: Shark Hat visuals[/b]
Updated materials and textures for a fresh new look.

[*][b]📝 Added: Save name validation[/b]
We now check for invalid characters when creating a save to prevent future issues.

[*][b]🎮 Improved: Return-to-menu positioning[/b]
When backing out of certain menus, you’ll now return to the correct in-game location.

[*][b]⛽ Fixed: Fuel interaction text translations[/b]
Fuel-related messages now localize properly.

[*][b]💥 Fixed: Mine explosion sounds not replicating in multiplayer[/b]
Explosions now correctly play sound effects for all players.

[*][b]🔊 Audio fixes [/b]
Large audio attenuations have been fixed, and certain sounds that previously lacked spatialization now have proper spatial effects.

[*][b]🔧 Fixed: Car parts snapping issues[/b]
Certain car parts that didn’t attach properly to others now connect correctly.
[i]Note: This fix doesn’t cover all snapping issues yet — we’re still actively investigating the remaining cases to improve attachment reliability across the board.[/i]

[/list]

Thanks again for your incredible support — especially for your detailed bug reports.
We’re making steady progress on performance and stability, and you can expect even more improvements in upcoming updates!

— The Drive Beyond Horizons Team

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – New POi, QoL, Attachables & Interaction Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve added one brand-new POI to the world of Drive Beyond Horizons! You can see a preview of it just below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/413a00e93541225c23d7cc75186172b55c7c6ab8.jpg[/img]

We've just pushed a new update addressing several bugs, visual improvements, and systems polish based on your reports:

[list]

[*][b]🚗 New: Unlock starting car selection via Restorer achievement[/b]
If you've completed the corresponding Restorer achievement, you can now choose that car as your starting vehicle in new games.

[*][b]🔧 Fixed: Attachables not syncing properly for clients[/b]
Attachable items were incorrectly snapping to the green preview boxes due to collision issues. This has now been resolved.

[*][b]🌙 Improved: Nighttime visibility[/b]
We’ve brightened the night slightly to help you see more clearly while exploring or driving.

[*][b]🛞 New: Steering assist setting[/b]
Added a gameplay setting that allows players to adjust the steering responsiveness of all steering wheels to their preference.

[*][b]🧭 Fixed: Roads not spawning due to player distance[/b]
A system now verifies player distance to ensure roads spawn correctly even in large worlds.

[*][b]💿 Fixed: DVD drive collisions[/b]
The CD/DVD player could launch itself when inserting a disc — we’ve removed its physics collisions.

[*][b]📦 Improved: Looters item variety[/b]
Some looter seeds were the same and caused multiple spawns of the same item — this has been addressed to improve variety.

[*][b]🚙 Fixed: Towing duplication bug[/b]
Towing a vehicle that was already towing another could cause duplication after loading a save — this is now fixed.

notes.title: Technical Overview
notes.content:
Hi Pilots!

In this first article, we'll delve into Open World Management.

As we approach the launch of the Alpha of Drive Beyond Horizons, we're excited to kick off this series of publications dedicated to our development journey.

[h2]Overview:[/h2]
Creating an infinite terrain poses several challenges that we need to tackle in the best way possible. No object can be "baked" as generation is entirely procedural, and it must be done within milliseconds without disrupting game performance. Let's dive in!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/aa027119d34435026d3752958da9ca6bf5bb120f.png[/img]

[h2]Terrain Meshing:[/h2]
For the terrain, we've opted for the "clipmap" technique as it allows for quick mesh creation and automatic LOD (Level of Detail) management.
For ease of programming, this clipmap is shared between the CPU and the GPU, unlike traditional clipmaps that reside solely on the GPU.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/72a71ef620fef0e2095e7a81da52d71f54b55267.gif[/img]

As you can see, the level of detail is automatically updated based on the camera position, saving GPU resources. It can also be adjusted in the options to display maximum quality or, conversely, to achieve better in-game performance!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/e8de74198c3bbf103d8bc0819f79839937228c92.gif[/img]

[h2]Terrain Texturing:[/h2]
When the player moves too far from the initial terrain position, textures are recalculated on the GPU. We've chosen not to use virtual textures, opting instead for a texture cascading system where textures are more detailed near the player than at the horizon. This allows us to update mountains and road elevations in real-time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/9cb5e1c0f664253203d433aa258a8c382cb12cf0.gif[/img]

[h2]Collision Handling:[/h2]
Collision is handled through previously created height textures. The data is processed on the GPU side and sent to the CPU only for the desired portion, ensuring that the processing is fast enough to run within a frame. This calculation is done for every object requiring collision on the terrain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/3931deba47c1cb73a0840de5ae0c4a5437ffae0a.gif[/img]

[h2]Vegetation:[/h2]
The most delicate management is vegetation because there are thousands of objects to instantiate in just a few frames. We take advantage of the relatively slow speed of the car to pre-generate the future foliage that the player will encounter. Meanwhile, we organize the foliage in the collision grid to make collision creation more efficient.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/70a01107f4867491feb11443c4f941f6d21a1029.gif[/img]

[h2]Conclusion:[/h2]
The terrain is at the heart of the game, and we've put a lot of care into its creation. We've successfully overcome the various challenges encountered so that you can drive beyond the horizons!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44897769/6037a62baa70f7635b83e12244c75eefd4a55cd1.png[/img]
